playstyle: Three sturdy Stormcast Eternals sharing Move 3, 5 health, and a shield save – elite but deliberate, trading speed for resilience. Each fighter carries both a melee and a range-3 attack, letting them engage at distance before committing. Their warscroll choice shapes the game-plan: either carrying two treasures into enemy territory to trigger a mass Inspire and lock down objectives, or anchoring in home territory where flanking is negated and re-rolls punish attackers. The warband wins by exploiting that durability to outlast opponents who cannot easily crack its tight, slow-moving core.
